description: Shorti(쇼티) for «what should I shoot this week?», «이번 주 뭐 찍지?», «find videos of…» or «… 영상 찾아줘». This week's breakouts to shoot, each with its move, who else made it and their version; by field, from the West or by taste. `about`: their words; a field Shorti keeps (요리, 카페): its week, else the nearest hits. `category` narrows a list. `lens`: radar (West first).

about.description: Their words. A field Shorti keeps a week for (요리, 살림, 카페, 피부과) answers that week; any other words (a product, an action, an @handle, Korean initials) the nearest hits it has read.

category.description: One of Shorti's categories, to narrow a list.

lang.description: 'en': Shorti's own English; never translate its Korean.

lens.description: radar: formats breaking out in the West no Korean video holds yet.

platform.description: Only formats with videos on this platform.

state.description: With radar: none in Korea yet, or the first ones.

name: shorti_what_to_shoot

for_you.description: true when a signed-in reader's own week leads the list

left_out.description: at an address whose host limits one answer's size: how many rows of each list did not fit, by the list's name; each list says its first rows

refusal.description: why nothing was answered, by name

today.description: today's rising hits, newest first, the asker's side first

week.description: the Monday (KST) the week's picks are fixed on

title: What to shoot this week
